sources.entry: Pimcore - Multi-channel experience and engagement management platform. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Pimcore is an open core platform for Product Experience Management that combines PIM, MDM, DAM, CDP, CMS and commerce tools on one API-driven data layer.
summary.what_it_does: Pimcore stores structured data (data objects with class-editor-defined models), files (assets with preview for 200+ formats and metadata/versioning), and pages (documents built with Twig templates and inline editables, with multilingual and multi-site support). Data is kept separate from output channels and delivered to websites, commerce systems, apps, print, digital signage, or headless consumers via REST and GraphQL. Functionality is split into a Core Framework plus modular Composer packages covering Datahub, workflow, automation, portals, personalization, OpenID Connect integration, and an e-commerce framework. The admin interface is Pimcore Studio, built with React. Each module is versioned and released together through the pimcore/platform-version package.
use_cases: manage product information across multiple sales channels
digital asset management for images and files
build multilingual websites with a headless or server-rendered CMS
expose content and product data via REST or GraphQL APIs
run a B2B or B2C e-commerce catalog, cart and checkout
automate data import, export and workflows
how_to_run: Install Docker and Docker Compose and make sure your user can run Docker commands and change file permissions.
Follow the Installation guide in the Pimcore documentation for the required steps.
Pimcore 2026.x runs via Docker for local development; no local PHP or Composer is needed.
notable: Single data layer serves both server-rendered Twig websites and headless REST/GraphQL consumers, and both can be combined in one project
Modular design where features ship as separate Composer packages under one platform version number
Asset handling previews 200+ file formats and auto-generates channel-specific outputs
Studio admin UI built on React and Ant Design
caveats: Licensed under the Pimcore Open Core License (POCL), which is not the GPL-3.0 label given in the listing; the README does not mention GPL
Some modules and features depend on the edition (Community, Professional, Enterprise, PaaS), so availability varies
summary.license: Pimcore Open Core License (POCL) per README; listing says GPL-3.0
